Salesforce native capture. Two authorized namespaced developer orgs supplied synthetic Account field sets with the same local API name and different namespace-qualified identities. A beta package version from the first org was installed into the second, where a separate field set with that local name was deployed. The second org had no Account field sets before setup. Anonymous Apex in collision.apex ran twice at API 62.0 and 67.0; all four executions compiled and succeeded. The rows record qualified and uppercase lookups, missing and local lookup controls, keySet, size, and values labels. Namespace identifiers were replaced consistently with synthetic identifiers in source and rows for publication; all observed values and relationships are preserved. The beta package installation and temporary field-set metadata were removed after capture.
After cleanup, baseline.apex was rerun at both API versions and each returned an empty Account field-set map. The recipient package inventory matched its pre-capture inventory and the source org no longer contained the temporary field set. The created package version remains a beta and was not released.
